claim: The routine_skip probe replays each update with one CALL skipped (recorded inputs, R values and interrupts) and compares RAM, and pacing_census reports time, frames and slack per update.

evidence.text: On Chuckie Egg skipping the attribute refresh left 133 of 133 updates identical and skipping the hens differed every update (negative control). Without recorded R values Inferno level 6 diverges.
